title: Stop hook gate: descent receipt, format strike, stop-menu and contentless-completion blocks
desc: The Claude Stop hook (wkharness-claude-stop.ps1) and its check registry: refuses a turn that ends on a stop-menu offer, a contentless completion, a missing descent receipt, or a format recite. The only hook seeing the model's own composed text -- and per-family, so it does NOT fire for agy or codex, which is why descent gates like the gc-tmp purge moved onto a TOOL CALL (an edit to HANDOFF.md) instead. Cluster: harness-stop-guard-howto (field contract, check inventory, wk-stop-test), harness-stop-guard-ref (dated design history).
steps: REFLEX-HEALING SHAPE: last paragraph starts Reflex-healing, two evidence lines directly under it: first wkappbot file read OFFICIAL_MD --keep quote, then wkappbot skill read CORE_ID --keep quote. Name ONE concrete thing from this turn. The branch skill (CORE_ID) must govern the named mistake: cite the skill that covers letter-posture if that blocked (road: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff-howto), not harness-stop-guard itself. //why:reflex-healing shape cited in report this turn-sonnet //why:will follow: reflex-healing shape last paragraph-sonnet //why:will follow: reflex-healing shape last paragraph-sonnet

STOP REPORT SHAPE: ONE prose paragraph (not bullets) naming one core skill id, evidence line directly under it, then the Reflex-healing paragraph with two evidence lines. Every bullet line counts as its own paragraph and fires skill-ref-gate. Road: inline any PREDICT or status note inside the cited paragraph itself, never as a separate block (example: 'PREDICT: sectors return gaps -- dispatched per on-load, sector A surveys gaps'). Open with the cited paragraph itself, zero preamble. //why:stop report shape one paragraph evidence line-sonnet //why:stop report shape one paragraph evidence line required-sonnet //why:stop report shape one paragraph evidence line required-sonnet
